verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack addresses SSO/SAML, enterprise identity providers (e.g., Okta, Azure AD), or cloud platform authentication for Copilot; docs cover agents, MCP, models, and governance features but not identity/authentication for enterprise compliance.
